note: Source is a complete draft design (PostgreSQL OntologyStore + SurrealDB KnowledgeStore). The plan therefore tests the draft against the code: which seams exist today, what the ArangoDB surface really is, and where the draft's assumptions (RDF/Turtle/IRI, SQLite per-repo, L1 synth cache) match or contradict the repository.

queries.intent: What is the existing ontology graph-store seam: protocol, backend registry and factory?
Which operations does the ArangoDB ontology graph store implement, and how much raw AQL do they carry?

params.hint: outline first (wikitoolkit symbols outline), then ranged reads of the public methods

queries.intent: Who constructs or calls the ontology graph store (blast radius of swapping the backend)?
Does AQL leak outside the store (callers building AQL strings, traversal patterns stored in ontology definitions)?
What is the ontology data model in code (entities, relations, traversal patterns, source format) and how does it compare to the draft's RDF/Turtle/IRI model?
Is there any RDF / Turtle / SKOS / OWL / IRI notion or dependency already in the repository?
How does ontology multi-tenancy map tenants to databases/graphs (candidate mapping to Postgres schema / Surreal namespace)?
What storage do the concept catalog and concept embeddings use today (already Postgres/pgvector?)
What is the wikitoolkit storage-backend abstraction (sqlite vs arango) that a SurrealDB KnowledgeStore would replace or implement?
What is the GraphIndex persistence seam (arango / postgres / sqlite backends, publisher) and where does the L1 synthesis cache live?
How does Bookstore persist its catalog/index today?
Which distributions declare ArangoDB dependencies/extras, and is surrealdb / rdflib / pyshacl / pgvector declared anywhere?
Which configuration variables drive ArangoDB today?

Full inventory of ArangoDB consumers OUTSIDE ontology/wiki/graphindex (vector store, legal/BOE, formdesigner sinks, manuals, contracts, routing, multistoresearch) — the part of 'remove ArangoDB' the draft does not cover
Which tests pin the ontology graph-store behaviour (reusable as a contract suite)?
How does the ontology RAG mixin use the graph store at query time (traversal, degradation to vector-only)?
